description: This file defines the GatewayTooBusyException class, a custom exception used within the Orleans runtime to indicate that a gateway silo is overloaded or load shedding, and cannot accept messages at the moment.

classes.name: GatewayTooBusyException
classes.description: A sealed class representing an exception thrown when a gateway silo is too busy to handle requests. It inherits from OrleansException and provides multiple constructors for different initialization scenarios.

methods.name: GatewayTooBusyException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating the gateway is too busy.

methods.name: GatewayTooBusyException(string message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message for the exception.

methods.name: GatewayTooBusyException(string message, Exception innerException)
methods.description: Constructor that allows specifying a custom message and an inner exception for chaining.

methods.name: GatewayTooBusyException(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
methods.description: Obsolete constructor used during deserialization of the exception object.
